mapper.select: SELECT p.policy_id AS policyId, p.policy_code AS policyCode, p.policy_nm AS policyName, p.category_nm AS category, p.policy_dc AS description, p.value_type AS valueType, CASE WHEN p.system_policy_at = 'Y' AND p.policy_code = 'DELIVERY_PLAN_MODE' THEN to_jsonb(t.delivery_plan_mode)::text WHEN p.system_policy_at = 'Y' AND p.policy_code = 'OVER_DELIVERY_POLICY' THEN to_jsonb(t.over_delivery_policy)::text ELSE p.value_json::text END AS valueJson, p.options_json::text AS optionsJson, p.min_value AS minValue, p.max_value AS maxValue, p.unit_nm AS unit, p.version AS version, (p.system_policy_at = 'Y') AS systemPolicy, to_char(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM tb_system_policy p JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY p.system_policy_at DESC, p.category_nm, p.policy_nm, p.policy_id

SELECT p.policy_id AS policyId, p.policy_code AS policyCode, p.policy_nm AS policyName, p.category_nm AS category, p.policy_dc AS description, p.value_type AS valueType, CASE WHEN p.system_policy_at = 'Y' AND p.policy_code = 'DELIVERY_PLAN_MODE' THEN to_jsonb(t.delivery_plan_mode)::text WHEN p.system_policy_at = 'Y' AND p.policy_code = 'OVER_DELIVERY_POLICY' THEN to_jsonb(t.over_delivery_policy)::text ELSE p.value_json::text END AS valueJson, p.options_json::text AS optionsJson, p.min_value AS minValue, p.max_value AS maxValue, p.unit_nm AS unit, p.version AS version, (p.system_policy_at = 'Y') AS systemPolicy, to_char(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM tb_system_policy p JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.policy_id = #{policyId}

SELECT p.policy_id AS policyId, p.policy_code AS policyCode, p.policy_nm AS policyName, p.category_nm AS category, p.policy_dc AS description, p.value_type AS valueType, p.value_json::text AS valueJson, p.options_json::text AS optionsJson, p.min_value AS minValue, p.max_value AS maxValue, p.unit_nm AS unit, p.version AS version, (p.system_policy_at = 'Y') AS systemPolicy, to_char(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM tb_system_policy p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.policy_id = #{policyId} FOR UPDATE OF p
SELECT t.delivery_plan_mode AS deliveryPlanMode, t.over_delivery_policy AS overDeliveryPolicy FROM tb_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO tb_system_policy ( tenant_id, policy_code, policy_nm, category_nm, policy_dc, value_type, value_json, options_json, min_value, max_value, unit_nm, version, system_policy_at, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT t.tenant_id, #{policyCode}, #{policyName}, #{category}, #{description}, #{valueType}, CAST(#{valueJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{optionsJson} AS jsonb), #{minValue, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{maxValue, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{unit}, 1, 'N', #{actorId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{actorId, jdbcType=BIGINT} FROM tb_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} RETURNING policy_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_system_policy SET policy_nm = #{policyName}, category_nm = #{category}, policy_dc = #{description}, value_json = CAST(#{valueJson} AS jsonb), options_json = CAST(#{optionsJson} AS jsonb), min_value = #{minValue, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, max_value = #{maxValue, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, unit_nm = #{unit}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{actorId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND policy_id = #{policyId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_system_policy_history ( tenant_id, policy_id, policy_code, action_cd, before_value, after_value, before_snapshot, after_snapshot, changed_by ) SELECT t.tenant_id, #{policyId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{policyCode}, #{action}, CAST(#{beforeValueJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{afterValueJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{beforeSnapshotJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{afterSnapshotJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{actorId, jdbcType=BIGINT} FROM tb_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.action_cd AS action, COALESCE(u.user_nm, h.changed_by::text, '') AS changedBy, to_char(h.changed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS changedAt, h.before_value::text AS beforeValueJson, h.after_value::text AS afterValueJson FROM tb_system_policy_history h LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = h.changed_by AND u.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.policy_id = #{policyId} ORDER BY h.changed_at DESC, h.history_id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nm AS userName FROM tb_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.use_at = 'Y'
AND u.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\'
ORDER BY u.user_nm, u.user_id LIMIT 50
